title: Notice: Frequent manual updates across platforms until v1.8.0 release
evidence: I am aware that frequent upstream updates to Electron and Chromium (often arriving every other day) currently require users across all platforms to manually re-download and reinstall Mise Browser to keep everything running smoothly. I recognise that having to constantly reinstall updates is frustrating and disrupts your workflow. I am actively working on a comprehensive packaging overhaul for the upcoming **v1.8.0** release to streamline this process. *** * **Current status:** Upstream system Electron updates or base runtime revisions can cause runtime and ABI mismatches immediately after system upgrades. * **Current workaround:** Until v1.8.0, you must pull and reinstall the latest Mise release / package whenever Electron or system dependencies update. * **Current status:** Security patches and rapid upstream Electron cycles require manually downloading and executing the latest installer or updating the portable binary folder. * **Current workaround:** Grab the newest setup executable from the Releases page when a new release is posted to ensure Chromium security patches are applied. * **Current status:** Due to frequent runtime bumps, users must manually replace the `.app` bundle in `/Applications` with each new release build. * **Current workaround:** Download the latest DMG / archive from GitHub Releases and overwrite your existing installation. *** The **v1.8.0** release focuses directly on resolving this update friction across all operating systems: * Streamlined distribution workflows. * Improved update mechanisms to eliminate repetitive manual re-installations. * Synchronised runtime packaging so you spend time browsing rather than maintaining your browser. Testing for v1.8.0 is currently underway across all environments to guarantee stability, security, and performance. I appreciate your patience while this testing is carried out. Please hold tight and bear with me for just a little longer whilst we polish and validate v1.8.0. Thank you for testing Mise and for your continued support!
